A_remedy.procedure: reset running mean/var, forward 50 batches of held-out training data (disjoint from the recovery subset) in train mode with cumulative averaging and no gradient, then evaluate in eval mode
A_remedy.A1: post-recalibration eval-mode benign_to_attack <= 0.05 on every reproduced collapse
A_remedy.A2: post-recalibration eval-mode family macro-F1 >= 0.95 x the batch-statistics value
A_remedy.A3: recalibrating a HEALTHY epoch changes benign_to_attack by <= 0.01 and family macro-F1 by <= 0.02, so the remedy does no harm where none is needed

definitions.normalisation_collapse: an epoch with eval-mode benign_to_attack > 0.10 whose batch-statistics benign_to_attack is <= 0.10: bad only under stored statistics
definitions.degradation: an epoch with benign_to_attack > 0.10 under BOTH evaluation modes: the model is genuinely bad, e.g. undertrained; NOT counted as a collapse

conditions.baseline: Adam 1e-3 constant, batch 1024, BN momentum 0.1 (reproduces NB27/28)
conditions.cosine_decay: Adam 1e-3 -> 1e-5 cosine over all steps, batch 1024

B_trigger.outcome: count of NORMALISATION collapses per condition across the four cells; degradation epochs reported separately
B_trigger.eliminates: zero normalisation collapses in all four cells
B_trigger.trains_adequately: median final family macro-F1 >= 0.90 x the baseline value; a condition that eliminates collapse by failing to train is reported as such
B_trigger.note: baseline must reproduce at least one collapse or the ablation is uninformative

C_seed_variance.design: shallow, fisher, 5 seeds [101,211,307,401,503], 8 units on the 10% subset, baseline vs cosine_decay
C_seed_variance.outcome: SD across seeds of final-unit AWBIR, and normalisation-collapse count, per condition
C_seed_variance.reporting: descriptive ratio with a bootstrap 95% interval; no pass/fail gate
